slides.headline: More than 100 firefighters responded before sunrise
slides.body: More than 100 firefighters responded early Tuesday to a five-story Miami apartment building after flames broke out on the fourth floor.

photo.query: Miami firefighters ladder truck apartment fire night smoke
photo.prompt: Firefighters and ladder trucks outside a five-story Miami apartment building before sunrise with smoke and emergency lights

slides.headline: The fire started on the fourth floor
slides.body: First responders said the flames broke out on the fourth floor and spread through the building before dawn.

photo.query: apartment building fire fourth floor smoke firefighters ladder truck
photo.prompt: A five-story apartment building with smoke coming from a fourth-floor unit as firefighters work below

slides.headline: 15 residents were displaced
slides.body: Officials said 15 residents lost access to their homes, including children and elderly people.

photo.query: Miami fire rescue apartment evacuation emergency vehicles smoke
photo.prompt: Fire rescue crews outside a Miami apartment building after an evacuation, with emergency vehicles and smoke in the background

slides.headline: Two people were transported with smoke inhalation
slides.body: CBS News reported two residents were transported after the fire because of smoke inhalation.
